children: Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD) shares climbed about 8% after reports that the companies are discussing concessions aimed at resolving legal challenges tied to Paramount's proposed acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery. The transaction faces opposition from California and 11 other states that have sued to block the deal on antitrust grounds.

According to reports, Paramount has discussed investing $1.5 billion in California film and television production as part of a potential settlement. Other proposals under consideration include maintaining studio operations in California and preserving production commitments tied to the combined company.

The companies are also evaluating measures that could address concerns surrounding the merger, including potential asset divestitures and governance provisions related to CNN. Settlement negotiations are ongoing and no final agreement has been reached.

The proposed acquisition, valued at about $81 billion according to recent reports, remains one of the largest media deals under review this year. Investors appeared encouraged by signs that negotiations with state officials may help clear a major obstacle to completing the transaction.

title: Warner Bros. Discovery Stock Soars as Paramount Makes Bold Merger Offer
